def.name: AnthracyclineFitness_FitRChop
def.display: Fit for standard R-CHOP (LVEF >= 50%, Age < 70, controlled comorbidities)

def.name: AnthracyclineFitness_UnfitCardiac
def.display: Cardiac dysfunction / CAD / RWMA / prior anthracycline toxicity (LVEF < 50%)

def.name: AnthracyclineFitness_UnfitElderlyFrail
def.display: Elderly with significant frailty / comorbid (Age > 70 with frailty)

def.name: AnthracyclineFitness_UnfitAnthraIneligible
def.display: Severe hepatic / renal / systemic contraindication to anthracyclines

def.name: AnthracyclineFitness_FrailPalliative
def.display: Frail / advanced decline (candidate for palliative / low-intensity therapy only)

def.name: CnsRiskSites_CnsHighRisk
def.display: High CNS risk (testicular, breast, adnexal, renal, adrenal DLBCL or DHL)

def.name: CnsRiskSites_CnsStandardRisk
def.display: Standard CNS risk (no high-risk anatomical involvement)

def.name: ViralScreeningHiv_HivPositive
def.display: HIV confirmed positive (requires CD4 count & ART coordination)

def.name: CentralVenousAccess_CentralAccessAvailable
def.display: Central venous access available (PICC line or chemo port in place)

def.name: CentralVenousAccess_NoCentralAccess
def.display: No central venous access / peripheral IV only

def.name: PrephaseIndication_PrephaseIndicated
def.display: Pre-phase indicated (elderly III/IV, bulky, GI involvement, poor PS)

def.name: PrephaseIndication_PrephaseNotIndicated
def.display: No pre-phase indicated (standard good PS non-bulky)

def.name: EcogPs_Ecog01
def.display: ECOG 0-1 (ambulatory, fully active or restricted light work)

def.name: EcogPs_Ecog24
def.display: ECOG >= 2 (capable of limited self-care, bed/chair > 50% waking hours)

element.value: Discontinue Doxorubicin -> Switch to R-CEOP (Etoposide replaces Doxorubicin)
Intrathecal Methotrexate (12 mg) with each chemotherapy cycle
High-Dose Methotrexate (3.0-3.5 g/m2) x 2 cycles after cycle 6 (DTPA GFR > 60 required)
Consider prophylactic radiation to both testes if testicular involvement
SC-RR-EPOCH (short-course dose-dense infusional EPOCH with Rituximab)
Opportunistic infection prophylaxis (TMP-SMX for PCP + fungal prophylaxis)
Interim PET-CT after cycle 2 (if CMR -> 1 more cycle, total 3; if not CMR -> 3rd cycle)
Infusional EPOCH without Rituximab (Rituximab avoided due to CD4 < 50)
Aggressive ART optimization & viral load monitoring
Re-assess CD4 count after ART response before subsequent therapy decisions
R-CHOP x 3 cycles (Rituximab, Cyclophosphamide, Doxorubicin, Vincristine, Prednisone)
If PET CMR: +1 more R-CHOP cycle (total 4 cycles, no radiation)
If PET positive: 3 more R-CHOP cycles OR 30-35 Gy IFRT
Involved-Field Radiotherapy (IFRT) 30-35 Gy to initial bulky disease site(s)
Mandatory 2D-ECHO after cycle 4 to monitor LVEF
Polatuzumab vedotin (1.8 mg/kg) + R-CHP x 6 cycles q21d
Rituximab monotherapy (375 mg/m2) x 2 additional doses
2D-ECHO mandatory after cycle 4 to screen for cardiotoxicity
Consolidative RT 30-35 Gy if PR with uptake at single residual site
R-CEOP x 6 cycles (Rituximab, Cyclophosphamide, Etoposide, Vincristine, Prednisone)
R-miniCHOP x 6 cycles q21d (attenuated doses + full-dose Rituximab 375 mg/m2)
Pre-phase Cyclophosphamide + Prednisone x 7 days prior to cycle 1
Mandatory Pegylated G-CSF support in all cycles
R-GCVP x 6 cycles (Rituximab, Gemcitabine, Cyclophosphamide, Vincristine, Prednisone)
Oral metronomic R-PEP-C (Prednisone, Etoposide, Procarbazine, Cyclophosphamide + Rituximab)
Radiotherapy alone if Stage I-II disease coverable in limited radiation field
DA-EPOCH-R x 6 cycles (continuous 96-hr infusional etoposide, doxorubicin, vincristine + bolus cyclophosphamide & rituximab)
CBC on Days 8, 10, and 12 of each cycle to calculate pharmacodynamic dose adjustment
Mandatory prophylactic G-CSF in every cycle
Interim PET-CT at cycle 4 and End-of-Treatment PET-CT at cycle 6
Consolidative RT to mediastinum if interim PET positive (DS 4-5)
